newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin down one cent to 14.98 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin down one cent to 14.98 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price ended a cent lower at 14.98 ringgit ($5.92) a kg after late buying prevented the local market from turning more bearish in response to the weak overnight on London.
"The local market was following the lower LME (London Metal Exchange) but some late buying saved the price from falling further," said a trader.

There were offers for 76 tonnes against bids of 62, leading to a turnover of 62 tonnes against 75 on Monday. The local price was at par with London, after trading at a discount of $30 on Monday. - Barani Krishnaan (603-2307509) ($1= 2.5290 ringgit).
